limitations: The result concerns first vanishing frequency Hamming degree only at lengths divisible by three, not total nullity, complete spectrum, other graphs, or noisy recovery.
scientific_integrity: The all-k proof uses exact finite-dimensional group identities, projective free-product ping-pong, and an induction; reproducibility tests are corroboration only. Historical priority is bounded and not certified.
title: Sharp first Walsh-zero degree for cyclic independent sets
